scope: Exact extraction of two completed preexisting analysis reports. No workload, test, build, resource JSONL scan or new acceptance gate; no in-progress final result was read.

phase.hashScope: Only this completed analysis report was read and hashed for this extraction; original raw/command/resource hashes below are copied from the report, not newly recomputed.

baseline.hashScope: Only this completed analysis report was read and hashed for this extraction; original raw/command/resource hashes below are copied from the report, not newly recomputed.

phase.allocationAttribution: All B/op and GC are whole-process totals. Business, harness, framework and driver costs are not separated or blindly subtracted; framework-only zero remains unproven by this report.

baseline.allocationAttribution: All B/op and GC are whole-process totals. Business, harness, framework and driver costs are not separated or blindly subtracted; framework-only zero remains unproven by this report.

metricDefinitions.sourcePointers: Every pointer is an absolute RFC 6901 JSON pointer within the identified completed report. The sourcePointers maps bind each renamed extraction field to its original field.
metricDefinitions.phasePopulation: All three original windows per route are pooled: 256 complete operations per window, 768 operations per route. Nearest-rank quantiles of observed durations; no trimming, averaging of quantiles, best-window choice or subtraction.
metricDefinitions.phaseFirstRow: SubmitToFirstRowTicks includes GetAsyncEnumerator, first MoveNextAsync and first DTO mapping; query/parameter/stream/List construction is separate.
metricDefinitions.phaseTotal: fourPhaseTotal is the quantile of each sample's ConstructTicks + SubmitToFirstRowTicks + ReadCompleteTicks + ReleaseTicks, not the sum of separate phase quantiles.
metricDefinitions.phaseCpuAllocationGc: Whole-process deltas summed over the three route windows, including verification, business DTO/string/codec work and harness. Not phase-local costs or full process-lifetime GC counts, and no framework-only subtraction.
metricDefinitions.phaseFirstExecution: Preparation and first execution are separate from steady windows; shared setup precedes them, so they are not independently process-cold.
metricDefinitions.phaseRelease: Dapper upstream iterator cleanup may occur inside ReadComplete; compare read+release and total, not Release alone.
metricDefinitions.mixedThroughput: Succeeded operations divided by elapsed time from offered start through drain. Offered duration is 120 seconds; drain can extend the denominator.
metricDefinitions.mixedQuantiles: Copied histogram quantile upper bounds, not exact nearest-rank raw samples. Offered/service populations contain successes, all_terminal_offered includes success+failure, start_delay includes all started.
metricDefinitions.mixedStartDelay: Planned-arrival-to-worker-start includes producer scheduling and queue delay; it is not isolated queue residence. Rejected arrivals have no fabricated completion latency.
metricDefinitions.mixedCpuAllocationGc: Actual application cumulative CPU/allocation endpoints bracket steady operations through drain; process-wide allocation and GC deltas include business/harness/driver. Setup/warmup/idle GC are not included. Wait4 process-lifetime CPU/maxRSS are copied separately.
metricDefinitions.mixedCpuDisplay: The Markdown CPU microseconds/success display is the report's seconds_per_success multiplied by 1,000,000; original seconds_per_success is unchanged in JSON.
metricDefinitions.managedFramework: FrameworkOnlyBytes remains null/unproven. No result allocation is subtracted.
metricDefinitions.host: Recorded host identity is index-bound evidence, not exclusive hardware/cgroup qualification. Original resource hashes are retained without rereading JSONL.
metricDefinitions.finalCredit: No final 1800-second observations are included or accepted by this extraction.
